review_scope: Independent bounded source and regression-test review; no independent test rerun.
scope_limits: This is an independently versioned three-pair feature contract, not equivalence to the historical795-column matrix, learned model input, or directional evidence.
Shared USD legs, own-return inclusion and overlapping windows create dependence. Peer counts are not independent trials.
Replayed capture seals bind caller-provided source observations; downstream registration must provide the expected source digest and independently retain actual captured bytes.
Archive close-at-label-plus60 semantics are explicit; original historical first arrival is not proven and candle tradeability is not inferred.
verified_properties: Tail reads retain exact source bytes, observation clocks and geometry with stable-file and reparse checks. Partial failed peers remain explicit.
One common real price-close cutoff controls exact1/15/60-minute endpoints; no fallback substitutes a shorter window.
ATR requires15 exact consecutive close timestamps for14 true ranges with previous-close gaps. Missing support preserves raw deltas but withholds normalization.
Native pips are fixed to the explicit three-pair metadata;96-digit local Decimal arithmetic prevents ambient context dependence.
Currency legs use base positive and quote negative, including USD opposite orientation in USD/JPY. Own-return strength and unavailable independent currency peers are explicitly labeled.
Rank, breadth and sample dispersion use actually available scoped peers; absent values remain null and the three-pair sample is not a historical68-pair replica.
Future-at-source-observation bars reject. Post-cutoff but already observed bars do not enter endpoint or ATR features; actual source/consumer availability is not backdated.
